description: Zero-Trust Agentic Guard: Reads a sensitive local file (.env, config, credentials, source code, database dumps), sanitizes all credentials and PII in volatile RAM, and returns safe tokenized content for AI agent context.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to inspect.

max_lines.description: Optional line cap for large files. Defaults to 500.

profile.description: Detection profile. Available: 'Dev' (default), 'General', or any of the 30 specialized industry profiles. Defaults to 'Dev'.

sector.description: Optional alias for 'profile'. The industry sector or compliance vertical to apply (e.g. 'medical', 'finance', 'legal', 'dev', 'hr', 'accounting', 'security', 'compliance', 'underwriting', 'telecom').

name: guard_read_file
